title: Phase I open-label, multi-center study to evaluate the safety, tolerability, dosimetry, and preliminary activity of [177Lu]Lu-NNS309 in patients with pancreatic, lung, breast and colorectal cancers.

Locally advanced or metastatic unresectable colorectal
cancer (CRC)
Locally advanced unresectable or metastatic breast cancer (BC)
